items.title: Why AI competition from China won't be a risk US tech companies
items.summary:
Host Mark Malek, Siebert Financial's chief investment officer, and his panel of experts weigh in on whether competition from China is a risk to US tech companies.

Today's panel includes Barron's reporter Jacob Sonenshine, The Technology Letter's Tiernan Ray, Epistrophy Capital Research Chief Market Strategist Cory Johnson, and Laffer Tengler Investments CEO and chief investment officer Nancy Tengler.

items.title: Is Broadcom (AVGO) Stock Stretched Or Still Reasonable On Cash Flow?
items.summary: Broadcom has ridden the AI infrastructure story into the top tier of global chip suppliers, which raises a simple question for you as a shareholder or potential buyer. Is the current price really supported by the cash the business is expected to generate over time, once the headlines fade? Over the past 5 years the stock has returned about 5.8x, which puts a lot of future cash flow assumptions under the microscope for anyone coming in today. items.title: Is Your VOO Fund Secretly An AI Bet?
items.summary: Most people treat an S&P 500 index fund as the safe default. The AI sell-off reads like a tech-stock story that index owners can watch from the side. The fund's own holdings say otherwise. About one dollar in four in the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO) sits in six AI giants.
